title: Equirectangular Inverse-Sampling Pinhole Camera Reprojection Engine
author: God's Eye View / Antigravity Cognitive Audit

claims.assertion: Forward projection from 360 equirectangular spherical panoramas to pinhole cameras produces pixel gaps and tear artifacts; inverse mapping over destination pixels with bilinear interpolation guarantees hole-free reprojection.
